items.html: Now, Atik and Arich, who are called the Keter of Atzilut, take between the two of them the two phases of the name MA, namely: the Taamim, which are Keter, and the Nekudot, which are Hochma. For the entire male side of Atik is made from the Keter, which is the Taamim of MA. And the entire male side of Arich is made from the Hochma, which is the Nekudot of MA. Thus, the Keter of Atzilut alone — which is the phase of Atik and Arich — takes the Keter and the Hochma of MA for their male side, and both of them together are called only the Keter of Atzilut.
